run_main_eval_pipeline: run the main evaluation pipeline that loads DISK model and processes HPatches dataset
create_DISK_model: create a DISK feature detector model with configurable window size and descriptor dimension
extract_features_with_model: extract keypoints and descriptors from batched images using DISK model features method
match_descriptors_between_images: match descriptors between original and warped image feature sets
cache_dataset_with_transform: cache dataset processing by applying a transform function to each element
